final: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total FROM budget_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT total_cost, expense_count, (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_spend) as avg_spend FROM budget_totals WHERE total_cost > (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_spend)) SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total_above, SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses_altogether, AVG(total_cost - avg_spend) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
